entities.name: MAP3K5 (Q62862)
observations: Rat MAP3K5 exact sequence match: 448 aa; reference identity and coverage both 100%.
Acts as a scaffold for a MAP3K2/MAP3K3–MAP3K5–MAPK7 signaling complex; annotated roles include ERK5 signaling and cytosolic localization.

Rat annotation reports alternative-isoform-dependent membrane localization; pathway roles include stress-apoptosis protection, neuronal survival, cardiac development, and angiogenesis (some by similarity).

entities.name: ERK5 cascade
observations: MAP3K5 is annotated in the ERK5 cascade and is reported to scaffold a MAP3K2/MAP3K3–MAP3K5–MAPK7 signaling complex.

entities.name: Cytosol
observations: Rat MAP3K5 reference annotation reports cytoplasm/cytosol localization; membrane localization is reported for an alternatively spliced isoform context.
